title: Top of Manhattan
description: Head to one of the highest points in Manhattan for a sweeping Hudson River and Palisades view near the Met Cloisters.
steps: Take the A train to 190th St and walk into the park.
Find Linden Terrace overlooking the river.
Photograph the team with the George Washington Bridge in frame.
Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take an uptown A train.
Ride to 190 St (A).
Walk ~6 min to the quest spot.

place: Gantry Plaza State Park, Long Island City
title: Skyline From Across the Water
description: Get the classic Midtown skyline from Queens, with the historic Pepsi-Cola sign in the frame.
steps: Find the restored gantries on the river.
Line up the Empire State Building and the Pepsi-Cola sign.
Photograph the team, skyline behind you.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to Times Sq-42 St.
Transfer to a Queens-bound 7 train and ride to Vernon Blvd-Jackson Av.
Walk ~8 min to the quest spot.

title: Spell It on the Lawn
description: Participating teams lie on the grass and spell a Friendsgiving word together, one letter per team, photographed from as high as you can manage.
steps: Setup: Three teams spell "PIE" (one letter each).
Each team forms one letter with their bodies.
Ask a passerby to photograph from a slight rise or with an arm held high.
proof: 1 group photo where the word is readable.
note: Sheep Meadow closes in late fall; use the Great Lawn or any open lawn instead.

steps: Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown B/C train.
Ride to 72 St (B C).
Walk ~7 min to the quest spot.

title: Ask a Local
description: Find a real New Yorker, ask for their favorite cheap eat nearby, then go and eat it.
steps: Confirm they live in the city (a tourist doesn’t count).
With permission, film them giving the recommendation.
Go there and photograph what you ordered.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train.
Ride to Christopher St-Sheridan Sq (1).
Walk ~2 min to the quest spot.

place: Anywhere with street vendors (suggested: Union Square)
title: What’s Your Name?
description: Buy something from a street vendor, learn their name and one thing about them.
steps: Buy something small.
Ask their name and how long they’ve had the spot.
Ask before taking any photo.
proof: 1 photo (with permission) + text: name and fact.

steps: Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train.
Ride to 6 Av (1 2 3 F L M).
Walk ~10 min to the quest spot.

title: Follow the Directions
description: Phones away. Ask a stranger how to get to a landmark 10–15 minutes away, then follow their directions exactly.
steps: Choose a destination before you ask.
Film the stranger’s directions (with permission) or narrate them afterward.
Film your arrival, or where the directions actually took you.
proof: 2 videos: the directions and the arrival.

steps: Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown B/D train.
Ride to Grand St (B D).
Walk ~8 min to the quest spot.

title: Pay It Forward
description: Buy a coffee for the next person in line and write up what happened.
steps: Tell the cashier you’d like to pay for the next order (set a budget).
Let the person know if they ask.
Write up their reaction.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to 6 Av.
Transfer to a Brooklyn-bound L train and ride to Bedford Av.
Walk ~1 min to the quest spot.

place: Any Little Free Library (suggested: Park Slope)
title: Note in a Book
description: Leave a kind, anonymous note in a book in a Little Free Library for the next reader.
steps: Find a Little Free Library box on a residential block.
Tuck a handwritten note inside a book.
Leave a book of your own if you have one.
proof: 1 photo of the note in the book (blur any names).

steps: Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a Brooklyn-bound B train.
Ride to 7 Av (B Q).
Walk ~11 min to the quest spot.

place: Union Sq–14 St station (or any busy station)
title: Support the Underground
description: Tip a subway or street performer and ask for a photo with them.
steps: Listen to at least one full song or act.
Tip, then ask politely for a photo.
If they say no, film 5 seconds of the act instead.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to Times Sq-42 St.
Transfer to a downtown N/Q/R/W train and ride to 14 St-Union Sq.
Walk ~1 min to the quest spot.

title: Compliment Chain
description: Give 15 sincere compliments to strangers around Washington Square Park and capture one great reaction.
steps: Give 15 genuine compliments (no pickup lines).
Keep a running tally.
Film one reaction, with permission.
Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown A/B/C/D train.
Ride to W 4 St-Wash Sq (A B C D E F M).
Walk ~5 min to the quest spot.

title: Hello in Five Languages
description: Queens is among the most linguistically diverse places on Earth. Learn "hello" in five languages from people who speak them.
steps: Start around Main St in Flushing or Roosevelt Ave in Jackson Heights.
Ask people to teach you hello in their language.
Film each teammate repeating it back, with permission.
proof: Videos + text list of the five languages.

steps: Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to Times Sq-42 St.
Transfer to a Queens-bound 7 train and ride to Flushing-Main St.
Walk ~1 min to the quest spot.

title: Stereotype Bingo
description: Collect five classic NYC sights in one outing.
steps: Find: a hot dog cart, a pigeon on a statue, a person dressed head to toe in black, an orange-and-white steam stack, and a bodega with a cat.
Photograph each one, with a teammate pointing at it.
Combine into one collage if you can.
Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown B/D train.
Ride to 42 St-Bryant Pk (7 B D F M).
Walk ~2 min to the quest spot.

title: Pun Intended
description: Find the most groan-worthy pun in a real business name or sign.
steps: Scan storefronts, awnings and menu boards.
Photograph the sign with a teammate groaning.
The Game Master ranks the puns at the end.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to 6 Av.
Transfer to a downtown L train and ride to 1 Av.
Walk ~8 min to the quest spot.

title: Pizza Rat Returns
description: Reenact the viral 2015 Pizza Rat video near the station where it was filmed.
steps: Buy one slice (one teammate is the rat).
Film the rat "dragging" the slice down a short section of stairs, on the wall side.
Keep it under 10 seconds and away from rush hour.
note: Don’t block other riders. Eating the prop afterward is encouraged.

steps: Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to 6 Av.
Transfer to a downtown L train and ride to 1 Av.
Walk ~1 min to the quest spot.

title: Pigeon With a Plan
description: Photograph a pigeon doing something un-pigeon-like: riding a train, standing on a sign, "reading" a menu.
steps: Keep your distance; don’t feed or chase them.
Wait for the perfect moment.
Give the photo a caption.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to Times Sq-42 St.
Transfer to a downtown R/W train and ride to 23 St.
Walk ~1 min to the quest spot.

title: Maximum Tourist
description: Commit fully to being the most stereotypical tourists in Times Square for 10 seconds.
steps: Look up, mouths open, map out (paper is a bonus).
Film from the red steps with billboards behind you.
Add a voiceover in your best "first time in the big city" voice.
note: Costumed characters will ask for tips if you photograph them.

steps: Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train.
Ride to 50 St (1).
Walk ~5 min to the quest spot.

title: The Manhattan Bridge Frame
description: Shoot the famous Washington Street view, Manhattan Bridge framing the Empire State Building, but make it absurd.
steps: Stand in the middle of Washington St only when it’s safe (it’s a live street).
Everyone holds a random object as if it’s an award.
Give the image an award-show title.
Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a Brooklyn-bound A/C train.
Ride to High St (A C).
Walk ~7 min to the quest spot.

title: Freeze!
description: On a signal, every participant freezes mid-motion for 60 seconds in a public plaza. Film the reactions around you.
steps: Setup: Two teams freeze on opposite sides of the plaza and film each other.
Agree on an exact time in the group chat.
Scatter across the plaza and pick a mid-motion pose (tying a shoe, mid-bite, mid-high-five).
One person per team films a different angle.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to Times Sq-42 St.
Transfer to a downtown N/Q/R/W train and ride to 14 St-Union Sq.
Walk ~1 min to the quest spot.

place: The Pond & Gapstow Bridge, Central Park
title: Peak Leaf
description: Capture the best fall foliage shot in Central Park with the stone Gapstow Bridge and Midtown towers behind.
steps: Enter at Fifth Ave & 59th and walk to the Pond.
Frame the bridge with orange and red trees.
Take a version with your team in it too.
Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown B/D train to 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr.
Transfer to an uptown F train and ride to 57 St.
Walk ~6 min to the quest spot.

place: W 69th St between Central Park W & Columbus Ave
title: Best Dressed Stoop
description: This Upper West Side block is known for going all out on fall and Halloween stoop decorations. Find the most over-the-top one.
steps: Walk the block from both sides.
Photograph the winner from the sidewalk only.
Find one decoration in the same color as a teammate’s outfit.
note: Decorations peak in late October. Never climb residents’ stoops.

steps: Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train.
Ride to 72 St (1 2 3).
Walk ~7 min to the quest spot.

title: Pumpkin Where It Shouldn’t Be
description: Find a pumpkin or gourd in the most unexpected place in the city.
steps: Look in bodega windows, office lobbies and fire escapes.
Photograph it in context.
The weirdest location wins a tiebreaker.
Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown C train.
Ride to Spring St (C E).
Walk ~7 min to the quest spot.

title: Pumpkin Spice Triple
description: Find three different pumpkin-spice products in the wild: a menu board, a shelf, a cart.
steps: Each product must come from a different shop.
Photograph each with a teammate’s skeptical face.
Rank all three on a "spice level" from 1 to 5.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train.
Ride to 34 St-Penn Station (1 2 3).
Walk ~3 min to the quest spot.

title: Farm to Friendsgiving
description: Buy one Friendsgiving ingredient straight from a regional farmer at the city’s best-known farmers market.
steps: Go on a market day (Mon, Wed, Fri or Sat).
Buy one seasonal item (apple cider donuts count).
Ask the farmer where the farm is.
proof: 1 photo + text: farm name and town.

steps: Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train.
Ride to 6 Av (1 2 3 F L M).
Walk ~10 min to the quest spot.

place: Around the American Museum of Natural History (W 77th–81st Sts)
title: Balloon Night
description: On the evening before Thanksgiving, the Macy’s Parade balloons are inflated on the streets around the natural history museum. All teams go together.
steps: Setup: Three teams each photograph a different balloon.
Only on Wednesday, Nov 25, 2026. Confirm public viewing hours and the entry point.
Shoot one group video in the viewing line.
note: Date-dependent. Only offer this if the trip includes Thanksgiving Eve.

steps: Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown B/C train.
Ride to 81 St-Museum of Natural History (B C).
Walk ~2 min to the quest spot.

title: Sunset Thank-You
description: All teams meet on the waterfront at sunset and each gives a 15-second "what I’m thankful for" toast, with Manhattan behind you.
steps: Setup: Two teams each give a 15-second toast, filmed in one take.
Check the sunset time and meet 20 minutes early.
Each team toasts with any drink (cider works).
Film every toast in one take, or stitch them together.
Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown B/D train to 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr.
Transfer to a Brooklyn-bound M train and ride to Marcy Av.
From the station it’s a ~17 min walk; a local bus or cab is quicker for the last stretch.

place: Village Halloween Parade, Sixth Ave from Spring St
title: Costume Collective
description: All teams wear one coordinated group costume to the Village Halloween Parade, where anyone in costume can march.
steps: Setup: Two teams form one two-part costume (for example salt and pepper).
Only on Oct 31. Check the official site for line-up rules.
Each team plays one part of a single themed costume.
Get a group photo in the line-up and a video of the march.
note: Date-dependent. Only offer this if the trip includes Oct 31.

steps: Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown C train.
Ride to Spring St (C E).
Walk ~1 min to the quest spot.

title: Hold the World
description: Travel to the steel globe from the 1964 World’s Fair and hold it in your hand with forced perspective.
steps: Take the 7 train to Mets–Willets Point and walk into the park.
Line up a forced-perspective shot so the globe sits in a teammate’s palm.
Also take one shot with the full team and the globe.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to Times Sq-42 St.
Transfer to a Queens-bound 7 train and ride to 111 St.
From the station it’s a ~16 min walk; a local bus or cab is quicker for the last stretch.

title: Wild Bronx
description: Visit the country’s largest urban zoo and grab a team selfie with an animal behind you.
steps: Check hours and tickets ahead (the zoo is a paid admission).
Pick your animal: gorilla, tiger, sea lion.
Selfie with the animal clearly visible.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to 96 St.
Transfer to a Bronx-bound 2 train and ride to Bronx Park East.
Walk ~12 min to the quest spot.

title: End of the Line
description: Take the subway to the end of the line and complete the Coney Island trifecta: boardwalk, Wonder Wheel and a hot dog.
steps: Take the D, F, N or Q to Coney Island–Stillwell Ave.
Photograph the team on the boardwalk with the Wonder Wheel behind.
Eat a hot dog at Nathan’s original location.
proof: 2 photos + text: how long the ride took.
note: Most rides close for the season in fall; the boardwalk and Nathan’s stay open.

steps: Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a Brooklyn-bound D train.
Ride to Coney Island-Stillwell Av (D F N Q).
Walk ~3 min to the quest spot.

title: The House That Ruth Built
description: Visit the Bronx’s ballpark and pose outside like you just hit a walk-off.
steps: Take the 4, B or D to 161st St–Yankee Stadium.
Find a big Yankees logo on the exterior.
Recreate a home-run trot or a celebration pile.
Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a Bronx-bound B/D train.
Ride to 161 St-Yankee Stadium (4 B D).
Walk ~3 min to the quest spot.

place: Astoria Park, under the Hell Gate Bridge
title: Hell Gate
description: Head to Astoria Park, where the Hell Gate and RFK bridges meet over the East River.
steps: Walk to the riverfront path between the two bridges.
Photograph the team with the steel arch of the Hell Gate behind.
Grab a Greek pastry or a frappé on Ditmars Blvd and name it.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to Times Sq-42 St.
Transfer to a Queens-bound N/W train and ride to Astoria Blvd.
From the station it’s a ~16 min walk; a local bus or cab is quicker for the last stretch.

title: Borough Passport
description: In a single day, collect proof that your team set foot in all four allowed boroughs: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens and the Bronx.
steps: In each borough, photograph a street sign or landmark that proves where you are.
Each photo must include a teammate.
Text the time of each stamp.
note: Staten Island is off-limits for this trip and doesn’t count.

steps: Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown B/D train.
Ride to 34 St-Herald Sq (B D F M N Q R W).
Walk ~4 min to the quest spot.
Plan a loop: Bronx and Manhattan first, then Queens via the 7 and Brooklyn via the A or L.

title: Simultaneous Snap
description: At one exact agreed minute, teams in different boroughs each take a photo of the sky. Then post them side by side.
steps: Setup: Three teams in three different boroughs.
Agree on the minute in the group chat.
At that minute, photograph the sky plus a borough landmark.
proof: 1 photo per team + one combined post.

steps: Walk ~9 min to 145 St on St Nicholas Ave and take a downtown B/D train to 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr.
Transfer to an uptown F train and ride to Roosevelt Island.
Walk ~5 min to the quest spot.
Each team heads to a different borough before the agreed minute.

title: Wave Across the Bridge
description: Teams position themselves at the Manhattan end, the middle and the Brooklyn end of the bridge, then wave to each other on camera.
steps: Setup: Two teams start at opposite ends and meet in the middle.
Assign positions in the group chat.
At a set time, every team waves and films the next team down the line.
Then all teams walk to the middle for a group photo.
Walk ~3 min to 145 St on Broadway and take a downtown 1 train to 6 Av.
Transfer to a downtown F/M train and ride to Delancey St-Essex St.
Walk ~7 min to the pedestrian entrance at Delancey & Clinton Sts and head onto the bridge.
